thumbnail_prompt: ONE image, two text versions. Show the VIEWER living the moment, never a musician performing (6.11% vs 3.03% CTR). Pichwai/Kangra miniature, aged cream parchment, ornate border. The instrument may rest at the frame edge; never held, never played. Text in its own banner panel at ~35% of frame, dark-teal serif, with a small second tier line under it. Scene: dusk interior, a person lying back on a daybed, one hand resting on the chest, eyes closed mid-exhale, a single oil lamp, deep indigo sky through the arch. Heavy, grounded, safe. A surbahar rests against the wall at the frame edge. Second tier line: 'Surbahar · Deep Calm · 1.5 Hours'.
music_direction: Low, resonant and grounding, but keep it MOVING - a continuous drone and regular phrasing; the inert sub-50-BPM beds are what collapsed 3hr retention to 12%. Retention target AVD >= 26%. No Suno prompt supplied.

description:
Stop Chasing Every Thought | Surbahar | 1.5 Hours of Deep, Slow Calm

One thought leads to another, and another, and you are following all of them. Your heart is a little fast, your shoulders a little high, and you cannot seem to switch off.

This deep Indian instrumental music is designed to give your body the signal that it is safe to slow down - the low, resonant voice of the surbahar draws your breathing longer and lets the thoughts pass without being chased.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of unhurried surbahar (bass sitar) melodies over a steady tanpura drone - warm, grounding, and free of vocals or sudden changes.

Perfect for anxious evenings, overthinking, racing thoughts, slowing your breath, settling after work, meditation, grounding, journaling, a quiet bath, or preparing for sleep.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Surbahar (bass sitar) with tanpura
Raga: Bageshri (tender evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Grounding, tender, safe
Atmosphere: Lamp-lit evening, nothing left to do
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Sit or lie down somewhere comfortable. Breathe out a little longer than you breathe in, and let the low notes set the pace. You do not need to stop your thoughts - just stop following them. Headphones deepen the bass resonance.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Nothing to solve tonight
9:00 Longer, slower breaths
18:00 Letting thoughts pass
27:00 Shoulders start to drop
36:00 Deep grounding resonance
45:00 A steady, quiet heart
54:00 Held by the low notes
1:03:00 Stillness without effort
1:12:00 Soft, safe and slow
1:21:00 Gentle fade into quiet

⏱ BEST FOR
• Overthinking and racing thoughts
• Anxious evenings
• Slowing your breathing
• Calming a fast heartbeat
• Grounding after a hard day
• Meditation
• Journaling
• A warm bath or quiet tea
• Easing into sleep
• Moments when you cannot switch off
